description: Will the cluster accept these Kubernetes manifests? Validates them against the OFFICIAL schema of the Kubernetes version you target (1.33–1.37; checked against kubeconform --strict): unknown fields with the one you probably meant (a typo in livenessProbe silently leaves the pod without a probe), wrong types ("80" where an integer goes), missing required fields, removed APIs with what to migrate to. And Pod Security Standards, ported from the official admission controller: the highest level each workload meets, what it violates (the controller's own check ids), and whether its namespace's pod-security.kubernetes.io labels would reject it. If you include RBAC (Roles, Bindings, ServiceAccounts), what each pod could do if compromised: read secrets, exec into pods, escalate…. Not covered: CEL rules, formats, CRDs (reported as not validated). For who-can-reach-whom, use k8s_network_reach.
